description: I am a student who is passionate about technology, innovation, and space exploration. I enjoy learning new skills, solving problems, and creating projects that can inspire others. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, I hope to use creativity and teamwork to develop solutions that make science more engaging and accessible.
summary: Echoes of Exploration is an interactive educational platform that brings NASA’s abandoned spacecraft, rovers, and landers to life through storytelling. Students explore the Moon and Mars, hear each mission’s story, discover scientific achievements, complete quizzes, and earn badges, making space exploration engaging, memorable, and inspiring for young learners.
details:
Echoes of Exploration is an interactive educational platform that teaches students about NASA’s abandoned spacecraft, rovers, and landers through storytelling. Users explore the Moon and Mars, click on different missions, and learn about their history, discoveries, and impact through engaging first-person stories and quizzes.

Our goal is to inspire curiosity about space and STEM while making NASA’s historic missions fun and easy to understand. We designed our project using Canva and planned to build it with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Firebase, and NASA’s public mission data. Our project is unique because it brings forgotten spacecraft to life, creating an emotional and educational experience for young learners.
